analysis.convention: One MAC = two arithmetic operations. FLOPs on quantized/mixed ops are floating-point-equivalent counts. Core arithmetic only.
analysis.shapePolicy: Serialized concrete dimensions only; symbolic shape signatures make arithmetic estimates unknown.
limitations: These numbers are not per-operator timings and do not predict CPU/GPU latency.
Unknown operators have null counts and are excluded from subtotals, never silently counted as zero.
Bias, fused activation, quantization, comparisons, indexing, memory movement, delegates and kernel implementation details are excluded.
Counts use dense padded kernels and do not discount sparse weights or boundary padding.
All subgraphs are counted once. Branch selection, loops, calls and runtime shape changes are not modeled.

summary.coverageMeaning: Fraction of operator nodes with a core-arithmetic formula, including data-movement nodes with zero arithmetic. Not the fraction of model compute or runtime covered.
summary.scope: Each serialized operator node counted once across all subgraphs; not an execution trace.
